# `identity_check`

Area: **selfcare** ([all tables](README.md))

Durable outbound identity check of a signup; sent and polled by the billing worker through the identity adapter, never inside a request.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no |  | Idempotency key sent to the identity service. |
| `care_signup_id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `state` | `text` | no | `'pending'::text` | pending (to send, or retried after a temporary error), sent (the service has it and has not decided), passed, failed, review (a person must look), exhausted (temporary errors used up the attempts: the signup goes to an operator). |
| `request` | `jsonb` | no |  | What is sent: the person and the address; every retry sends it unchanged. |
| `attempts` | `integer` | no | `0` |  |
| `next_attempt_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  |  |
| `last_error` | `text` | yes |  |  |
| `reason` | `text` | yes |  | The service's reason for a failed or review verdict. |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  |  |
| `attempted_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  |  |
| `decided_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  |  |
